New 'Digimon' Anime Announced for 2027
The official X (formerly Twitter) account of the Digimon anime franchise announced an anime project on August 1. The new series is scheduled to air in 2027. The Digimon franchise began in 1997 as a virtual pet game and later gained popularity with the 1999 anime Digimon Adventure (Digimon: Digital Monsters). 'Hotaru no Yomeiri' Unveils Additional Cast, Ending Theme, Second Teaser Promo
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Oreco Tachibana's Hotaru no Yomeiri (Firefly Wedding) manga unveiled additional cast, ending theme, and teaser promotional video on Sunday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 9 at 11.30 p.m. on Fuji TV noitaminA. Voice actors Kent Itou (Wotaku ni Koi wa Muzukashii) and Kenjirou Tsuda (Jujutsu Kaisen) are joining the cast as Kotaro Ogawa and Saegusa, respectively. 'Mato Seihei no Slave' Gets Third Season
The Mato Seihei no Slave 2 (Chained Soldier Season 2) special event announced a third anime season on Sunday, revealing an announcement visual and promotional video. Produced by Seven Arcs, the first season aired for 12 episodes in Winter 2024. The second season, by Passione and Hayabusa Film, aired from January 8 to March 26.
